stock.description: Strawbear Entertainment Group specializes in the funding, creation, production, and distribution of television series, web series, and motion pictures. Its operations span both the People's Republic of China and international markets. The company commercializes its self-produced drama content by licensing broadcasting and other intellectual property rights to television channels, streaming platforms, and third-party distributors. Furthermore, it provides bespoke production services, developing custom drama series based on commissions from online video platforms. Strawbear also engages in the management and development of literary copyrights, alongside screenplay evaluation and creation. The group was established in 2014 and maintains its headquarters in Nanjing, PRC.
